description: Extra-axial mass lesion located in the cistern bulb left of the cerebellum apparently extending into the jugular foramen. Slightly heterogeneous signal in T2, post gadolinium enhancement, with tiny likely cystic areas in between. The mass exerts minimal mass effect on the left middle cerebellar peduncle.
